Problem and contribution

During my internship at Innorize, I helped build a responsive web application for online debate and discussion. I worked on the frontend and REST APIs.

Architecture, tradeoffs, and results

I used Tailwind for the interface, MongoDB for persistence, and JWT authentication for the APIs. Caching and lazy loading improved load speed by about 30% in the project measurements. The résumé figure describes the changes measured during the internship and can vary by page and network.
